verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge documents a deletion capability: owners can delete pages, gated by role. Knowledge data lives in the user's own configured storage provider, which gives some control over where it is held. Nothing documents retention controls such as TTLs, auto-expiry, retention policies, or purge and erasure workflows. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or expiry, bulk or scope-level deletion, documented handling of notes and version history on delete, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: an owner can also delete pages and move them between scopes
Knowledge is stored in your configured storage provider, which adds its own `mastra_knowledge_*` tables the first time Knowledge is used
